result.summary: Found 1 major issue: a section header shows an untranslated localization key instead of actual content.

issues.description: Second restaurant section header displays raw localization key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable translated title
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the correct localized string (e.g. 'Popular near you') and add fallback / QA check to prevent untranslated keys reaching production
